2. It does NOT resolve the tag to actual instance IDs - it only offers an optional preview command but doesn't execute it or report resolved instance IDs; it says 'I can check... if you'd like' rather than actually doing it.

4. --max-errors is set to "1" instead of the expected "0".
5. There is no --document-version pinned in the command - the document-name is used without a version pin.
